positions.name: researcher
positions.brief: Review the named profiling services and primary PHP advisories. Use only the existing five-domain passive batch. Do not send requests to candidate hosts, discover additional targets, run probes or payloads, or contact owners. Record source provenance and uncertainty.

positions.name: maintainer
positions.brief: Maintain concise evidence in the attached repository. Keep PHP usage separate from vulnerability status. Commit and push reviewed passive-research changes only using the configured repository credential. Do not add candidates to active scope, alter scope, disclose secrets, or publish findings.

positions.name: reviewer
positions.brief: Review evidence quality and JSON consistency independently. Flag unsupported vulnerability claims. Enforce the five-domain passive batch and zero candidate-host requests. Do not change scope, run probes, discover targets, or contact owners.
